Resource pack builds of Fresh Moves Fix, a fork of [Fresh Moves](https://github.com/IthanMendoza/Fresh-Moves) by IthanMendoza.

**Which file?**

- `Fresh-Moves-Fix.zip` - works for every version from 1.20 to 26.3 (recommended)
- `Fresh-Moves-Fix-mc<version>.zip` - the same pack labelled for one Minecraft version
- `Fresh-Moves-Fix-Eyes-Only.zip` - only the eyes are animated; the body keeps Minecraft's own movements (every version from 1.20 to 26.3)

**Required mods:** the latest [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures).

These builds have not been tested in-game. On Minecraft 1.21.5 and newer the cape and elytra animations may not work correctly.

**New in 3.1-fix8:** the Eyes Only ZIP now includes its own install notes, explaining that body emotes and sitting are not available in that variant. The model animations are unchanged and remain untested in-game.

**New in 3.1-fix7:** a talking mouth switch for skins with the mouth marker. Tap sneak twice quickly while looking forward to start it, and again to stop. It does not follow real voice chat. Not tested in-game.

**New in 3.1-fix6:** a moving mouth. Skins made with the Mouth option of the website eye editor open the mouth when the player is hurt, cheers or waves. Other skins look the same as before. Not tested in-game.

**New in 3.1-fix5:** six more emotes. Stand still, look straight up and tap sneak: 1 wave, 2 cheer, 3 clap, 4 dab, 5 dance, 6 jumping jacks, 7 T-pose. Look away or walk to stop. Also a sit emote. Stand still, sneak and look straight down, and the player sits on the ground. Not tested in-game.

**New in 3.1-fix4:** an "Eyes only" pack (`Fresh-Moves-Fix-Eyes-Only.zip`): blinking and moving eyes, eyebrows and eyelashes, without the body animations and without the wave emote. Not tested in-game. The normal pack files are unchanged.

**New in 3.1-fix3:** the install notes inside the zips name the EMF version needed on Minecraft 26.x (26.1 - 26.1.2: EMF 3.3.2 or newer; 26.3: EMF 3.3.6 or newer). The pack files themselves are unchanged.

**New in 3.1-fix2:** a wave emote. Stand still, sneak and look straight up, and the right arm waves.
